actions.result_status: Beale announced a new Tulsa County campus and groundbreaking. The developer page describes a planned $1 billion investment, up to 100 permanent roles, a five-year initial phase buildout, PSO electric infrastructure upgrades, and Washington County Rural Water District No. 3 water-line upgrades. The current Beale location page describes expected capacity of 500 MW and about 506 acres; the MW figure remains developer-reported and not independently confirmed as energized IT load.
actions.access_caveat: Developer source; it does not establish a Tulsa County vote, permit, parcel, or utility energization.
actions.evidence_note: Body/context retained from prior file: Beale Infrastructure.

contradictions.details: Beale/current secondary references describe approximately 506 acres; official TID project-area legal description/Commerce summary covers approximately 399-400 acres for the incentive/project area. Treat 506 acres as broader campus/control acreage and 399-400 acres as the formal TID/project area unless later plats clarify otherwise.

Developer announcement says $1 billion and a five-year initial phase; Beale location page and official TID plan describe at least $700 million per phase across four planned phases, while local chamber/media report total potential investment up to $3 billion. Use official per-phase amounts for incentive mechanics and developer $1 billion as groundbreaking announcement framing.
